title: Task
description: A task or reminder (tasks.json item). A reminder is a task with remind_at; it fires once (fired=true), snoozing sets a new remind_at and fired=false.

id.description: Stable id, unique per record type (10 lowercase hex chars from new records; any string accepted).

updated.description: Last change time (ISO). Sync: the newer 'updated' wins; ties -> the lexically greater 'device'.

device.description: Device that made the last change, e.g. 'windows-<hash>' or 'android-<hash>'.

deleted.description: Tombstone: true = deleted. Kept (not removed) so the deletion syncs.

remind_at.description: Reminder time, ISO minutes precision (2026-11-15T17:00), or null for a plain task.

created.description: ISO 8601 local time, seconds precision, no offset (e.g. 2026-11-15T09:30:00).
